description: FIX THE MERCHANT CENTER SETTINGS that stop an account serving (merchant_account_status names them). Pick section + action. shipping: get · upsert (add or update services by name; services you do not mention are KEPT) · remove (serviceNames) · replace (exactly this list). A service is {name, countries, currency, rate, freeOver?, handlingDays:[min,max], transitDays:[min,max], active?} or Google's own Service shape; delivery days are required, never guessed. returns: list · create (policy {countries, returnPolicyUri, days or policyType, itemConditions, returnMethods, processRefundDays, returnLabelSource, label?}) · delete (returnPolicyId). Google has no edit for a return policy. business_info: get · update (address, customerService {uri,email,phone}, koreanBusinessRegistrationNumber; merged field by field, null clears). homepage: get · claim (re-checks verification; overwrite:true takes it from another account) · unclaim · set_uri (removes the claim). programs: list · enable · disable (program e.g. free-listings, shopping-ads). Overwriting or removing a shipping service, replacing existing business info, deleting a return policy, unclaiming, changing a claimed homepage, overwrite:true and disabling an enabled program each answer with what would change and need confirm:true. Every write is read back from Google. Free.

address.description: business_info: regionCode, street or addressLines, locality, administrativeArea, postalCode

confirm.description: true ONLY after the user approved the change the first call described

koreanBusinessRegistrationNumber.description: Korean business registration number; business_info update only

overwrite.description: homepage claim: take the claim from another account

section.description: shipping, returns, business_info, homepage or programs; the Merchant Center area to act on

warehouses.description: shipping: Google Warehouse objects; omitted = existing ones kept

name: manage_merchant_settings
title: Change Merchant Center settings
